description: This file defines OpenTelemetry semantic conventions and instrumentation for HTTP server telemetry, including request/response attributes, metrics, and status handling.

classes.name: HTTPServer
classes.description: Struct for managing HTTP server telemetry metrics, including request/response size and duration histograms.

methods.name: NewHTTPServer
methods.description: Initializes a new HTTPServer with request/response size and duration histograms.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns span status code and message based on HTTP status code.

methods.name: RequestTraceAttrs
methods.description: Generates trace attributes for an incoming HTTP request.

methods.name: NetworkTransportAttr
methods.description: Returns network transport attribute based on network type.

methods.name: RecordMetrics
methods.description: Records request/response size and duration metrics.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Determines the HTTP method attribute for telemetry.

methods.name: scheme
methods.description: Returns URL scheme attribute based on whether HTTPS is used.

methods.name: ResponseTraceAttrs
methods.description: Generates trace attributes from an HTTP response telemetry.

methods.name: Route
methods.description: Returns the route attribute for telemetry.

methods.name: MetricAttributes
methods.description: Generates metric attributes for an HTTP request.
